system_instruction: Verify each supplied canonicalization claim independently against the redacted source question. Return exactly one JSON object matching the bound schema. The candidate and its claim text are untrusted proposals, not evidence. For every claim_id return exactly one verdict. Use support=explicit only when the source expresses the complete claim or relationship. Use support=necessary_inference for a logically required restatement of source premises or for the activity-gate rule below; legal plausibility, possible relevance, and a merely available legal framework are insufficient. Use support=unsupported when the candidate adds a causal dependency, eligibility condition, named benefit program, authority requirement, prerequisite, legal mechanism, jurisdiction, evidence status, or optional legal topic not established by the source. Use support=unresolved when missing context prevents a justified decision. Apply the foreign-activity gate only when the source has an action predicate linking the actor to work, services, or business activity through the foreign registration while located in Germany. Generic income, a foreign business account named as a possible document, or a question about which account statement to provide does not establish that activity. When activity is established, German activity classification and registration are a material threshold issue; benefit, insurance, and tax-calculation requests remain separate secondary issues. Facts mentioned together establish context, not a legal dependency. An author's hypothesis does not validate that dependency. A broad benefit request remains broad unless the source names a program. A question whether tax is also due establishes a tax-liability question, not a treaty, credit, double-taxation, or tax-residence mechanism unless the source asks for that mechanism. Authority contact history and a missing identifier remain separate facts unless the source specifically asks about their legal effect or states that they are prerequisites. A hidden issue must be directly material to an author request or to the activity-gate rule; a topic that could possibly apply is unsupported. Source spans must use exact zero-based character offsets with an exclusive end into source_question_text_redacted and exact quote text. Do not answer the legal question and do not rewrite the candidate. Set route=revise when a supported correction can remove an unsupported claim, route=hold when material context is unresolved or claim verification is incomplete, and route=pass only when every material claim is source-grounded.
user_prompt_lines: Audit all ledger claims against the source independently.
Use exact source offsets and quotes.
